svg.title: 07 DFD Level 1 - Main Processes
svg.desc: Named data flows between individual processes, external entities and data stores; repeated IDs denote the same endpoint.
svg.text: Named data flows between individual processes, external entities and data stores; repeated IDs denote the same endpoint.
F1: 1.0 Identity and setup -> 4.0 Usage event persistence: Identity milestone events
F2: 2.0 Learning and assessments -> 4.0 Usage event persistence: Learning and assessment timing
Blue: external entity. Green: process. Amber with double lines: data store. No entity-to-store or store-to-store shortcuts.
